about_the_game:
Ollsgar’d is a bold reimagining of the classic marbles game—now reimagined into a fast-paced, challenging, and totally unique experience! With innovative mechanics, fast-paced gameplay, and voice control, you can play however you want! Whether you’re shouting, clapping, using your dog, playing instruments, or anything in between, you’ll have a hilarious and highly entertaining experience.

What is Ollsgar'd?

Ollsgar'd is nothing more than a marbles game where you battle using voice control.

  • Game mode with 999 rounds.

  • Prove yourself a master marble player by reaching the long-awaited 999+ round!

  • Marble battles.

  • Sujis competition.

  • An interesting story.

  • Every game is a challenge.

  • Challenge yourself by playing Ollsgar'd not only with your voice, but also with instruments, claps and other things that your creativity allows.

Game rules:

Ollsgar'd is simple and easy to learn:

Roll the die:

When spinning, you set the speed of your marble on the platform, where the player must keep dodging obstacles to gain the "Sujis" advantage. If you lose, your opponent gains the advantage, being able to position protections around the Arena.

After that, the battle begins, where the balls compete for the "Lonely Balls" and whoever scores the most points wins.
